name: Miniamin
overview: Miniamin was a male member of the tribe of Levi, noted for his role in distributing portions to his brothers. His service reflects the responsibilities entrusted to the Levites in the organization and support of the community. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Miniamin means 'from the right, good, fortune,' indicating a positive connotation associated with his identity. This proper name is not recorded as being given directly by God but carries a meaningful Hebrew significance.
familyAndRelationships: Miniamin is identified as a son of Levi, placing him within the Levitical lineage. Scripture does not record any further family relationships for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Miniamin's significance lies in his administrative role among the Levites, particularly in distributing portions to his brothers, which underscores the organized stewardship within the Levitical tribe. His function contributed to the orderly provision and support of the Levites, who were central to the spiritual and communal life of Israel.
